nodes.title: SG-8.1 Rebuild the contribution sheet on the Radix dialog
nodes.body:
Context: game/frontend/src/components/ContributionSheet.tsx renders a hand-made div with role=dialog, so it has no focus trap, no Escape handling and no focus restoration. @radix-ui/react-dialog is already a dependency but no wrapper exists under src/components/ui. Desired behavior: the sheet is built on the Radix dialog through a shadcn-style wrapper. Expected result: Tab stays inside the sheet, Escape closes it, focus returns to the Suggest What Happens Next trigger and the dialog exposes a title and description. Why: keyboard and screen-reader accessibility.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the sheet is open, when the player presses Escape, then onClose is called
- Given the sheet is open, when the player tabs past the last control, then focus stays inside the dialog
- Given the sheet closes, when the dialog unmounts, then focus returns to the Suggest What Happens Next trigger
- Given the sheet is open, then the dialog is labelled by a title and described by a description


## Scope
- In scope: Dialog wrapper in src/components/ui
- In scope: ContributionSheet rebuilt on it
- In scope: App trigger focus restoration
- Out of scope: Backend or API changes
- Out of scope: Changes to submission, quota or history logic
- Preserve: ContributionSheetProps open, onClose and roundId
- Preserve: POST /api/v1/contributions and listMine behavior
- Preserve: Existing labels Your idea, Send, Your suggestions


## Technical constraints
- Use the existing @radix-ui/react-dialog dependency
- Use cn from src/lib/utils
- No new dependencies


## Definition of done
- All three requirements implemented and verified by unit tests


## Non-functional requirements
- Keyboard accessible
- WAI-ARIA dialog semantics


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · A shadcn-style Dialog wrapper exposes Radix dialog parts
nodes.body:
Context: only button.tsx exists in src/components/ui. Desired behavior: a dialog.tsx wrapper exports Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogDescription and DialogClose built on @radix-ui/react-dialog, in the same forwardRef plus cn style as button.tsx. Expected result: any component can compose an accessible modal. Why: single reusable accessible base.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given DialogContent inside an open Dialog, when rendered, then an element with role dialog exists in the document
- Given DialogTitle and DialogDescription are rendered, then the dialog has aria-labelledby and aria-describedby pointing at them
- Given a className prop on DialogContent, then it is merged with the base classes via cn


## Scope
- In scope: New file src/components/ui/dialog.tsx
- Out of scope: Using it in ContributionSheet
- Preserve: ui/button.tsx


## Technical constraints
- forwardRef components
- Portal to document.body via Radix


## Definition of done
- dialog.tsx exports the named parts


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · ContributionSheet is a Radix dialog with focus trap, Escape and a title and description
nodes.body:
Context: ContributionSheet.tsx returns a plain div with role=dialog and a Close button. Desired behavior: render it inside Dialog with open and onOpenChange mapped to onClose, DialogTitle Suggest What Happens Next and DialogDescription Ideas are considered when the Round closes. Expected result: Escape closes, Tab is trapped, name and description are announced. Why: accessibility.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the sheet is open, when Escape is pressed, then onClose is called once
- Given the sheet is open, then getByRole dialog has accessible name Suggest What Happens Next and a non-empty accessible description
- Given open is false, then no dialog is rendered
- Given the Close button is clicked, then onClose is called
- Given existing submit and history flows, then they behave as before


## Scope
- In scope: ContributionSheet.tsx markup
- Out of scope: Submission and history logic
- Preserve: errorMessage export
- Preserve: Remaining count text
- Preserve: Send button and Your idea label


## Technical constraints
- Keep hooks before any early return


## Dependencies
- REQ1


## Definition of done
- Sheet built on ui/dialog parts


## Non-functional requirements
- Focus is trapped while open


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Closing the sheet returns focus to the Suggest What Happens Next trigger
nodes.body:
Context: App.tsx opens the sheet from a plain button via sheetOpen state. Desired behavior: the trigger is a ref-held button and the sheet passes onCloseAutoFocus that focuses it. Expected result: after Escape or Close, document.activeElement is the trigger. Why: keyboard users keep their place.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the sheet was opened from the trigger, when Escape is pressed, then the trigger has focus
- Given the sheet was opened from the trigger, when Close is clicked, then the trigger has focus


## Scope
- In scope: App.tsx trigger ref
- In scope: ContributionSheet optional returnFocusRef prop
- Out of scope: Other App behavior
- Preserve: Trigger text Suggest What Happens Next
- Preserve: roundId passing


## Technical constraints
- Optional prop so existing renders still work


## Dependencies
- REQ2


## Definition of done
- Focus returns to the trigger


## Clarifying questions
- None

steps.symbol: new: Dialog, DialogClose, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogDescription
steps.action: Create the file importing * as DialogPrimitive from @radix-ui/react-dialog and cn from ../../lib/utils. Export Dialog = DialogPrimitive.Root and DialogClose = DialogPrimitive.Close. Add forwardRef DialogContent that renders DialogPrimitive.Portal containing DialogPrimitive.Overlay (fixed inset-0 bg-black/60) and DialogPrimitive.Content with cn base classes and the className prop. Add forwardRef DialogTitle and DialogDescription over DialogPrimitive.Title and DialogPrimitive.Description, and DialogHeader as a div.
steps.code: export const DialogContent = forwardRef<ElementRef<typeof DialogPrimitive.Content>, ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof DialogPrimitive.Content>>(function DialogContent({ className, children, ...props }, ref) { return (<DialogPrimitive.Portal><DialogPrimitive.Overlay className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/60" /><DialogPrimitive.Content ref={ref} className={cn('fixed left-1/2 top-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2', className)} {...props}>{children}</DialogPrimitive.Content></DialogPrimitive.Portal>); });
steps.expected: Module exports the six named parts and type-checks
